checks.name: Curriculum schema carries stable identity, CEFR level, and integer sequence
Curriculum lesson ids and per-level sequence numbers are unique
Grammar curriculum is serialized in deterministic learning order
checks.details: every CEFR track is strictly ordered

checks.name: Grammar prerequisites point to earlier curriculum lessons
A1 grammar track contains a usable foundation
checks.details: A1 lessons=17; expected at least 14 ordered foundations

checks.name: Grammar hub consumes curriculum order instead of object/insertion order
checks.details: grammar renderer exposes an explicit curriculum/order path

checks.name: Grammar option order may shuffle while lesson order remains stable
checks.details: option randomization is allowed in question construction; lesson traversal must remain ordered

checks.name: Active learner level is a named persisted concept
checks.details: state/preferences must carry activeLevel or an equivalent learner-level field

checks.name: A single active-level resolver exists
checks.details: all panels should call one resolver rather than reading placement state directly

checks.name: Every learning domain reads the global active level
checks.details: vocabulary, grammar, reading, writing, classroom, adaptive, and speaking/listening are scoped

checks.name: Non-placement learning panels do not use an unscoped cross-level pool
checks.details: cross-level access is isolated to placement/level selection

checks.name: Placement remains the only explicit cross-level exception
checks.details: placement must declare placement:true when it builds the cross-level assessment

checks.name: Domain progress remains separate from active-level preference
checks.details: vocab/grammar/reading progress must not be stored as a replaceable level bucket

checks.name: Active-level changes are implemented through an explicit setter
Level switching persists without resetting learner progress
checks.details: setter saves the preference and does not clear domain evidence

checks.name: State revision or equivalent cache invalidation follows a level switch
checks.details: Core/adaptive caches must not keep the previous level after switching

checks.name: Behavioral progress continuity fixture
checks.details: active level changed A1 -> B1 and all evidence remained intact
